name: Savannasaurus
sum: Savannasaurus is a wide-hipped titanosaur from the Winton Formation of Queensland, Australia, the most complete Australian sauropod.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: The only known specimen, nicknamed Wade, held at the Australian Age of Dinosaurs museum.
biology: Its wide hips and robust humerus may have distributed its body weight more evenly.
author: Poropat et al. 2016
